figures.finding: The Thailand Film Office's cash rebate for foreign productions (from 1 January 2025) is tiered by spend in Thailand: 15% from THB 50 million, 20% for THB 100-150 million, 25% above THB 150 million, up to 30% with bonuses (5% for promoting Thai tourism and soft power, 5% for Thai nationals in key roles, further points for designated locations and Thai post-production).

value.name: Thailand Film Office cash rebate (Department of Tourism)

sources.said: Productions spending at least 50 million Baht are eligible for a 15% rebate. For spending between 100–150 million Baht, rebat
rease to 20%, while expenditures exceeding 150 million Baht qualify for a 25% rebate. The maximum rebate cap is 30%, inclusive of additional incentives.

A 5% bonus can be earned by promoting Thai tourism, Soft Power, and positive depictions of the country, provided these align with the criteria outlined in Form ICM 1. Productions employing Thai nationals in key roles are eligible for an additional 5%.

figures.finding: Thailand hosted 546 foreign productions worth more than THB 6 billion in 2025, and 218 worth THB 2.46 billion from January to April 2026, as the Tourism Authority of Thailand reports.

sources.said: the country welcomed 546 foreign productions with a combined value of more than 6 billion Baht in 2025, while 218 productions generated 2.46 billion Baht from January to April 2026.

figures.finding: The Department of Tourism's December 2024 announcement on the foreign film incentive removed the earlier THB 150 million per-project cap on the rebate, so it is paid on total qualified spend, and raised the maximum rate from 20% to 30%, the 15% base unchanged.

value.announcement: Announcement on Guidelines, Procedures, and Conditions for Applying for Benefits Under the Incentive Measures for Foreign Film Production in Thailand (Department of Tourism, December 2024)

figures.applies: Foreign productions in Thailand under the December 2024 announcement (in force from 1 January 2025 per the Tourism Authority).

sources.said: The 2024 announcement introduced major changes, including (1) removal of the rebate cap, previously set at THB 150 million (approx. USD 4.5 million) per project, enabling rebates based on total qualified spending, and (2) an increase in cash rebate rates. The maximum allowable cash rebate rate was increased to 30 percent from the previous cap of 20 percent. The base rate of 15 percent remains unchanged.
